args: set -eu; revision=$(node -e 'eval(Buffer.from(process.argv[1],"base64").toString())' '' /workspace/.agents/settings.yml) || { echo 'forge MCP: no pinned ai-outfitter/.agents revision in settings.yml' >&2; exit 1; }; cache_key=$(printf '%s#%s' 'git+https://github.com/ai-outfitter/.agents.git' "$revision" | base64 -w0 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '='); catalog=/workspace/.agents-cache/repos/$cache_key; launcher=$catalog/scripts/forge-mcp-launch.js; test -f "$launcher" || { echo 'forge MCP: launcher missing from resolved catalog checkout' >&2; exit 1; }; exec node "$launcher" "$@"
